name: root-kernel
description: Evidence-gated task delivery and development-tool setup workflows for Codex.

interface.longDescription: Root Kernel provides framework-agnostic development-tool setup and an orchestrated set of focused phase skills that carry one named roadmap task from planning through implementation, verification, refinement, documentation, review, and closeout.
defaultPrompt: Use $root-kernel:task-handler to handle one named roadmap task through its required evidence gates.
Use $root-kernel:dev-setup to diagnose and configure development tools for this repository.
